title: Local Docker and Coolify Deployment Parity
context: Ensure seamless deployment parity between local development container and remote Coolify instance.
decision: Use single multi-stage Dockerfile and consistent environment variables contract for both local Docker and Coolify deployment with non-destructive prisma migrate deploy.
alternatives: Separate Dockerfiles for local dev and Coolify
consequences: Single multi-stage Dockerfile works seamlessly locally and on Coolify
Non-destructive migration during container startup ensures zero data loss
risks: Production migrations must never use destructive commands like db push --force-reset.
